name: D-Link India Ltd
about: D-Link (India) Ltd is primarily engaged in marketing and distribution of networking products. It operates through a distribution network with a wide range of product portfolio and solutions with a nationwide reach across India.[1]
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio
Its portfolio includes different kinds of routers, switches, wireless devices, surveillance, network security, structured cabling, network infrastructure, and optical transport network products. [1]

pros: Stock is providing a good dividend yield of 4.64%.
Company has delivered good profit growth of 25.2% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 53.0%
